system.description:
This spell makes the touched creature resist fear effects. Any fear effect that allows a save will automatically be resisted by the target. The target is also allowed to make a doom save against fear effects that do not normally allow saves, with a bonus on the save equal to the caster's level.

Remove Fear can be cast on a target who is already afraid, and will either remove or allow an immediate save against the fear as above.

This spell will also remove the terror effect of an immortal's aura, but only when cast by an immortal.

Reverse: Cause Fear can be cast on any living creature within 120' and will make it flee in terror for 20 minutes unless it can make a spell save. If the target is cornered, they will cower and fight only to defend themselves.
